items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: he was the drummer with Josephine Baker, Patti Page and Frankie Laine

ctx.x: Yeah because he was the drummer with Josephine Baker, Patti Page and Frankie Laine and of course Buddy Rich’s assistant drummer and he managed the Buddy Rich band for 30 years. So it’s ironic that my business partner and my best friend, Stanley, was probably with Buddy in Binghamton when I was eleven.
